_readme: Copy to config.json (gitignored) and edit. Every field is OPTIONAL — omitted fields fall back to the built-in defaults for the selected useCase. See docs/CONFIG.md for the full reference. Nothing here is sent to the browser except the fields listed under 'Safe subset' in docs/CONFIG.md.

brand.name: Acme Labs
brand._domains: The domains this instance owns. Set this when the Resend account is shared with another brand: the webhook uses it to ignore events that are not yours. Omit it on a single-brand instance.

signature.text:
Best,
Your Name
Acme Labs - https://acme.example

labels.footer: Self-contained client — no external assets, no build step.

intro.label: Intro (first contact)
intro.subject: {{company}} × {{product}} — quick idea
intro.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I work on {{product}} and wanted to reach out about {{company}}.

Would you be open to a short note on what we do?

{{signature}}

fu1.label: Follow-up 1 (3–5 days)
fu1.subject: Re: {{company}} × {{product}} — quick idea
fu1.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Just floating this back up — making sure my last note did not get buried.

{{signature}}

leads._readme: Optional CRM tab. enabled:false hides it. stages are the pipeline (terminal:true ends the progression), dueDays is the follow-up cadence in days between sends, redraftReasons are the chips offered when you send a draft back.
leads._inbox_readme: discoverFromInbox:true turns a new inbound sender into a lead (a reply is a warm lead). ignoreSenders: exact addresses or domains (and their subdomains) that must never become leads - put your tools and your own domain here.
